name: Lash and brow studio

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Lash fill
services.story: The main story: a $70 lash fill with Kayla, 3 weeks or less after the last set. A card is saved for the studio's $20 fee. Alex pays at the desk.

services.name: Classic full set
services.story: The $140 Classic full set (2½ hours). A $40 deposit now, and $100 at the desk. A free glue patch test comes 1 to 2 days before a first set.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Diego and Luis (lash artists who travel)

services.name: Classic full set at home
services.story: The main story: a $179 Classic full set at Alex's home with Diego. A card is saved for the $89 trip fee. Rosie texts the bill after, with a tip line.

services.name: Wedding party lashes
services.story: Wedding party lashes for Alex and 4 friends, priced from the party's answers and a photo at $640, OK'd by Sam. A contract, a $160 deposit now, and the $480 rest charged to the saved card when Diego texts DONE.

services_shape: set appointments with a chosen artist; the length is set by the service, and a fill turns into a full set when the plug-in's fill rule isn't met
questions_before_times: new or returning, and for lashes: a first set, or the date of the last set or fill (it decides a fill or a full set, and the patch test)
which service: a fill, a full set, a lift, brows
for a full set: the look (natural, wispy or full)
for a wedding party: how many people, the date, and where everyone gets ready
safety_stop: glue or a chemical in the eye now
a reaction now: eyes or face swelling fast, or trouble breathing
eye pain or a change in sight after lash or brow work
first_steps: Glue patch test (a few test lashes at each outer corner)
Patch test for a tint, lift or lamination
Lash consent on the secure page
license: always where the state's rules license lash and brow work: lash extensions, lifts, tints, waxing and lamination fall under cosmetology, esthetics or an eyelash license, as the state form says
staff_skills: classic, volume, lifts, tints, lamination, waxing, threading, makeup; only artists with the skill and the license are offered
messages_never: eye-form answers, allergies, patch-test results and reactions never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the customer's record. Check texts ask nothing personal; the artist asks by phone
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
